name: Authenticator ℠ App
description:
Protect your online accounts with secure, standards-based two-factor authentication. Authenticator App – 2FA MFA generates time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) directly on your iPhone, giving you a reliable second step for sign-ins without depending on SMS codes.

Authenticator provides reliable security for both personal and work accounts. From email and social media to crypto platforms and business tools, the app helps keep your login information protected and easy to access. Commonly supported platforms include: Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter (X), LinkedIn, Amazon, Dropbox, PayPal, eBay, Snapchat, Pinterest, Reddit, Yahoo, Shopify, Slack, Zoom, Airbnb, Uber,... 

Access your authentication codes anytime, even without an internet connection. Codes are generated directly on your device, so weak signals or offline situations won’t block your sign-ins.

Key features

- Secure TOTP verification codes
Generate time-based one-time passwords that add a strong extra layer of protection to your accounts. These codes refresh automatically and work with most online services that support authenticator apps, helping keep your sign-ins secure.

- Fast and easy account setup
Add new accounts in just a few steps by scanning a QR code or entering a secret key manually. The setup process is simple and clear, so you can start using two-factor authentication right away.

- Full control over your 2FA accounts
Manage all your authentication entries in one place. You can edit account names, update secret keys, or remove entries anytime when accounts are no longer needed.

- App lock with Face ID, Touch ID, or PIN
Protect access to your authentication codes with biometric security or an app passcode. You can also enable auto-lock to automatically secure the app when you leave it or switch to another app.

- Built-in password storage
Store your website and app login details in a dedicated passwords section. Easily create, edit, copy, or delete credentials, giving you convenient access while keeping everything organized.

- Private in-app browser
Sign in to your accounts using the built-in browser designed for privacy. It does not save browsing history, logs, or cookies, helping reduce traces when accessing sensitive accounts.

- Clear settings and simple controls
Customize how the app works through clean and easy-to-understand settings. Manage security options and app behavior with full visibility, so you always know what features are active.
